s: Load each response's value array; index workspaces and datasets by id.
For each report: its dataset, workspace, owner (configuredBy), endorsement, latest refresh status (sort refreshes by startTime), and whether any ViewReport event mentions it.
Print the summary counts; write the table to CSV for the governance review.
Swap the load() function for authenticated GETs later; nothing else changes.

with open('inventory.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:

print('models without endorsement', sum(1 for d in datasets.values() if not d.get('endorsementDetails')))
print('models whose latest refresh failed', sum(1 for s in latest.values() if s == 'Failed'))

s: Entra ID → App registrations → New; record client ID and tenant ID; create a certificate (preferred) or client secret with an expiry and an owner who renews it.

Put the app in a security group; in Fabric tenant settings allow that group for "Service principals can call Fabric public APIs"; add read-only admin API access only if the inventory must cover the whole tenant.
Give the service principal Viewer (or Member if it must refresh) on the workspaces it inventories; not Admin.
Get tokens with the client-credentials flow (MSAL), scope https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api/.default for Power BI APIs or https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/.default for Fabric APIs.
Secrets: key vault or CI secret store; rotation calendar; alert before expiry.
api-rest-1.check: Allowed group + correct tenant setting + least workspace role + secret outside code + client-credentials flow.

s: Contain: rotate or delete the secret in Entra ID now; the old one stops working. Review the app's sign-in logs for unexpected use.
Clean up: remove the secret from the code, purge it from history (git filter-repo or BFG), force-push, ask everyone to re-clone. Treat it as compromised anyway.
Prevent: secrets only in a key vault or CI secret store, loaded from environment variables; enable secret scanning and push protection; add a pre-commit hook; document the rule in CONTRIBUTING.
api-rest-2.check: Rotate first, then clean history, then prevent recurrence.
